records.identified_transition: Eurostat IPI observation unit changes from LEU to KAU
records.formal_definition: sts_inpr_m / PRD / NACE Rev.2 B-D / SCA / I21
records.evidence_summary: Eurostat describes the pre-2021 LEU approximation and KAU compilation from 2021, with possibly insignificant aggregate breaks; Statistics Poland confirms that LEU and KAU can allocate production differently. The specific B-D SCA impact is not quantified or bridged.

overlap_audit.note: KAU and national LEU dissemination are documented, but no same-month, same-B-D, same-SCA paired extract was verified; numerical continuity is not used as definition evidence.

records.remaining_uncertainty: Exact B-D aggregate magnitude and a pre-2021 KAU bridge are unavailable; this warning is not a declaration of strict unit invariance.

frozen_loco_context.interpretation: composition sensitivity only, not break evidence

records.identified_transition: State-space monthly estimates from 2023 with 2011-2022 back-revision
records.formal_definition: une_rt_m / SA / TOTAL age / T sex / PC_ACT
records.evidence_summary: Eurostat's Hungary method row describes 2023 state-space monthly estimation and revision of January 2011 through December 2022, spanning all pre-2023 baseline months; the same harmonised ILO outcome and SA presentation continue. This is latest-revised comparability, not real-time vintage stability.
records.current_metadata_state: high_frequency_coverage: none_recorded / defined / analysis_eligible=true; current series has no post-2015 b or d flag in the stored exact query
records.remaining_uncertainty: Eurostat does not make the 2009-2010 relation to the state-space history explicit.

records.identified_transition: Eurostat exact-series observations marked e=estimated in 2025
records.formal_definition: irt_lt_mcby_m / MCBY / monthly percent per annum
records.evidence_summary: The latest Eurostat series marks Slovenia's 2025 values e. The flag denotes an estimated value, not a b definition break; Round 3 already retains these flags in the research matrix.
records.current_metadata_state: historical audit preserves e flags; frozen formal vintage is not relabelled as unflagged
records.required_metadata_change: none; preserve e disclosure and do not conflate latest revised with frozen vintage
records.remaining_uncertainty: Do not assume current estimated flags existed in the frozen publication vintage.
